subject: per-vt-u-fund
title: (R)PER.VT.U.FUND.-----MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 488 (MP(II)-6). PER-VT-U-FUND (perceived vibrational universe fundamental) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and LK-IMP (linkage implications). From T-C-IMP: STF (source transfer) and SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics). From LK-IMP: UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)). From SPT-DYM: MOT-DY. From UNF-PI: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From MOT-DY: IST-F (isolated focus).
